template.title: The Glistening Ball and the Kind Rabbit
template.summary: A child learns kindness by sharing a glowing ball with a shy rabbit in the park.

sentences.text_with_blanks: [[slot_child]] loved to play with [[slot_toy]] in the [[slot_place]].
One sunny afternoon, the [[slot_toy]] rolled into a small clearing.
It was a bright [[slot_color]] ball that glowed like a firefly.
Near the ball, a shy [[slot_pet]] hopped and stared.
[[slot_child]] felt the ball was fun, but the rabbit looked lonely.
[[slot_child]] almost kept the ball for themselves.
Then [[slot_child]] remembered how the rabbit seemed sad.
[[slot_child]] decided to give the ball to the [[slot_pet]].
The rabbit's eyes sparkled and it twirled the ball.
After a while, [[slot_child]] shared a [[slot_snack]] with the rabbit.
The rabbit nibbled, and they all curled up under a big oak tree.
